title: feat: wire polli-agent into the apps deploy pipeline
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Gives polli-agent a hostname. The config added in #12702 had **no routes**, which is why `polli.pollinations.ai` is NXDOMAIN despite a container already running.

- Registers `polli-agent` in `apps/apps.json` as a `worker` target on subdomain `polli`
- Moves `worker.js`/`package.json` from `deploy/cf/` to the app root, where `apps/_scripts/deploy.sh` expects them (same layout as `apps/websim`)
- Adds `wrangler.jsonc` with `custom_domain` routes for `polli.myceli.ai` + `polli.pollinations.ai`
- `instance_type: standard-1` — `standard` is deprecated

Verified with `wrangler deploy --dry-run`: `env.POLLI (PolliContainer)` binds, container resolves to `apps/polli-agent/Dockerfile`, no warnings.

**Merging this deploys** — the `apps/**` push trigger on `main` will run `Apps / Deploy changed apps`. First container build in this pipeline, so the image build step is untested here. No secrets required: every setting in `config.py` has a default and hosted runs take the caller's bearer.

Leaves the pre-rename `polly-agent` container (2 idle instances) alone.

gist.headline: Polli gets a front door
gist.blurb: Polli-agent was already awake in a container; it just did not have an address. Now the little helper has proper routes at polli.pollinations.ai and polli.myceli.ai.
gist.summary: Registered polli-agent in the apps deployment pipeline as a worker on the polli subdomain, with custom-domain routes for polli.pollinations.ai and polli.myceli.ai plus a standard-1 container binding.
gist.impact: Polli-agent can now be reached through its public hostnames instead of returning NXDOMAIN, and future apps-pipeline deployments will build and deploy its container from the expected app-root layout.

Polli wears a miniature mail carrier cap and proudly installs the address plaque while code-vines and flowers grow around the deployed container.
